title: customcontrolresource
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, customcontrolid_customcontrol, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

customcontrolid.description: Unique identifier of the custom control.

customcontrolresourceid.description: Unique identifier of the Custom Control Resource.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: Name of the custom control resource.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the Custom Control Resource.

webresourceid.description: Unique identifier of the web resource.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the web resource.
